method: median of24 guide-alpha16 silhouette height / whole painted actor-alpha16 silhouette height; one common scale, not applied
limitations: longer painted hair and drawn boot shape change silhouette, so this is initialization only
source-grid placement/height drift remains; no per-frame scale or anchor correction
registrationMethod: Once manually annotated, for each frame compute translation t_j = native_ankle_j - globalScale * painted_ankle_j (j=L,R), using original whole-frame coordinates. Shared mean translation estimates drawing-origin offset; t_L-t_R is bilateral leg-pose residual independent of translation. Include hip/heel/toe diagnostics, visibility and uncertainty; do not fit an occluded ankle. FootAnchor proposal in painted pixels equals (nativeRootPx - mean(t_L,t_R))/globalScale. Publish residuals and original/corrected loop before acceptance.
